lab_shift: the template lab_shift

Source: R/tpl_docs.R
tfl_tpl_lab_shift.Rd

The table template lab_shift, layout shift. Its program is one call, tfl_tpl(ard, "lab_shift", ...); a parameter a report leaves out takes the study standard's value, else the variant's default, else the layout's.

Parameters

ParameterTierStageDefaultMaps toWhat
populationrequiredcalloutput.populationthe analysis set's id (SAF)
subsetothercallwhich subjects (R, on the analysis set's ADSL): PART == "Part 1"
visitrequiredcallthe visit (AVISIT)
paramsrequiredcallthe PARAMCD values
whereothercallthe records kept besides the visit and parameters (R)
byothercallTRT01Asettings.treatmentthe column variable
data_idothercallthe analysis data's id; NULL: <data>_<population>
by_levelsothercallthe column variable's values in order; NULL: the ARD's (its code list)
param_labelsothercalleach parameter's heading (a named vector); given by name, merged
levelsothercallLOW, NORMAL, HIGHthe categories, in order
worstothercallHIGH, LOW, NORMALa subject once a parameter, at its worst category after baseline, the categories from the worst; NULL: every record (the baseline's records too)
worst_byothercalla parameter's own order from the worst, by its value (HGB: LOW, HIGH, NORMAL); the others take 'worst'
percent_ofothercalltotalwhat a cell's {p} is of, set apart from the header N ('header_n'): "total" (default) the Total row – the arm's subjects with both a baseline and a category after baseline for the parameter, so the Total is 100%; "row" the subjects of its baseline category
cellothercall{n}a cell's template
post_headerothercall{col}the header over each post-baseline category ('{col}': the category; a typed \n breaks the line)
missing_labelothercallthe row of the subjects with no baseline category, counted in the Total and in the % denominator; NULL (default): those subjects are left out of the table, not in any row or N
total_labelothercallTotalthe row of all the subjects; NULL: none
param_pageothercallTRUETRUE: a page a parameter, named in the titles by 'param_heading'
param_headingothercallParameter: {value}a parameter's page name ('{value}': the parameter); the last title line, or where the title line '{PAGE_HEADING}' is
header_nothercallsetthe arm headings' N, set apart from the % denominator ('percent_of'): "set" (default): the arm's subjects in the analysis set (with 'subset'); "tested": the page's subjects with a baseline and a post-baseline category (needs 'param_page'); "none": no N

Aliases

The same template by the names of other collections' items: each runs it as itself (tfl_tpl(x, "phuse_os_shift", ...)).

AliasCollectionItemTitle
phuse_os_shiftPhUSE CSSOS table shiftShift from normal to abnormal

Copyright PHUSE Limited, all rights reserved; cited by number only.

Analysis and Displays Associated with Adverse Events: Focus on Adverse Events in Phase 2-4 Clinical Trials and Integrated Summary Documents (white paper), Version 1.0, 3 February 2017. https://phuse.global/Deliverables (accessed 2026-10-28). The aliases follow the numbering of these publications, and the titles are short descriptions of our own, not their text. The templates are tflspec's, not endorsed or recommended by PhUSE.

Example

plan <- tfl_tpl(ard, "lab_shift", population = "SAF", visit = "CYCLE 2 DAY 1", params = c("ALT", "AST"))

See also

tfl_tpl(), tfl_tpl_help(), tfl_tpl_args(), tfl_templates()

tfl_tpl_help("lab_shift", tier = c("required", "usual"))
